selection: 1 known hidden-positive control, 12 risk-enriched ambiguous/non-reaction-likely video titles from distinct reactors, plus 17 deterministic seeded random videos from different remaining channels.
sampling_warning: Risk-enriched and intentionally balanced by channel; not a simple random sample. Do not extrapolate prevalence/precision from sample directly.

review_definition.match: Person in video genuinely reacts, comments upon or analyzes a Missioned Souls performance
review_definition.not_match: Band announcements, original covers without reaction, unrelated artists, promotions and reposts without a meaningful new reaction
review_definition.uncertain: Unavailable or cannot determine by watching
